# Kongwa Tech

> Kongwa Tech is a technology and strategy holding company that partners with founders and brands to build, scale and operate ventures at the intersection of AI, digital infrastructure and community.

Kongwa Tech deploys hands-on operating capability across:
- Product development
- AI implementation
- Platform engineering
- Audience growth

The company takes equity positions in select projects. This does not mean every collaboration or item of operating work is an equity holding.

## Key pages
- /: Company thesis, operating capability and selected work
- /consult: Project consultation
- /ai-stack: The AI tools and systems Lubosi Kongwa uses
- /team/lubosi-kongwa: Founder profile
- /blog: Kongwa Tech insights
